extensionName.message: Theater Mode Everywhere — One player to rule them all

extensionDescription.message: Expand any HTML5 video to fill the browser. Use custom controls, subtitles, audio effects and integrations with video services.

settingsSubtitle.message: Configure website exclusions, appearance, and theatre mode keyboard shortcuts.

createdByHtml.message: Created by Tomasz Janusz

appearanceDescription.message: Choose where the picture sits, and the accent for controls, sliders, shortcuts, and highlights.

pictureAlignCenterDescription.message: Picture stays in the middle of the screen. Best for 16:9 screens.

pictureAlignTopDescription.message: Picture sits at the top, with a black band below for subtitles. Best for 16:10 and 4:3 screens.

pictureAlignSubtitlesOnlyDescription.message: Use Raised when subtitles are on and Centred when they are off.

audioProtected.message: Audio effects are unavailable: this video is DRM-protected.

audioRefused.message: Audio effects are unavailable: the video’s server doesn’t allow it.

audioUnavailableHud.message: Audio settings are unavailable for this video

featuresDescription.message: Turn optional theatre mode behaviour on or off.

volumeBoostDescription.message: Amplify volume up to 300% using Web Audio API. A brief loading spinner may appear the first time you enter theatre mode while this is enabled.

richTheaterExperiencePopupDescription.message: Enable richer integrations only for this service.

youtubeIntegrationDescription.message: Available when provided by the video or player: Title, Subtitles, Chapters, Heatmap, Thumbnails. Quick actions: skip ads and next video in the queue. With YouTube Rich Theater Experience and Video launcher enabled, look in the player toolbar, just left of the autoplay switch.

vimeoIntegrationDescription.message: Available when provided by the video or player: Title, Chapters, Thumbnails. Quick actions: next showcase video.

patreonIntegrationDescription.message: Available when provided by the video or player: Title, Subtitles, Chapters, Thumbnails.

twitchIntegrationDescription.message: Shows the channel or video title, plus VOD subtitle selection, chapter markers and timeline previews when supplied.

disneyIntegrationDescription.message: Available when provided by the video or player: Title, Subtitles, Thumbnails. Quick actions: skip intro, recap or credits and next episode.

netflixIntegrationDescription.message: Available when provided by the video or player: Title, Subtitles, Thumbnails. Quick actions: skip intro, recap or credits and next episode.

bilibiliIntegrationDescription.message: Available when provided by the video or player: Title, Subtitles, Chapters, Heatmap, Thumbnails. Quick actions: native skip confirmations and next video.

tencentIntegrationDescription.message: Available when provided by the video or player: Title, Subtitles, Thumbnails. Quick actions: next episode through the player.

websiteExclusionsDescription.message: Exclude websites where you do not want theatre mode to activate automatically.

domainInputPlaceholder.message: e.g., youtube.com or paste a URL

exclusionsFooterTip.message: Tip: You can also manage exclusions directly by clicking the extension icon in your browser toolbar.

noExclusionsDescription.message: AutoTheater starts theatre mode on supported services. Add sites here to keep it off.

keyboardShortcutsDescription.message: Click any input field and press your desired key combination to configure. Modifiers like Ctrl, Alt, and Shift are supported.

cycleSwitchPlayerDescription.message: Works only when the page has more than one HTML5 video.

onlyOneVideoHud.message: Feature unavailable. Video switching is only possible when there are more players on the page.

cycleIframeHud.message: Switching works only with HTML5 video

privacyThingPopoverBody.message: Here is my new extension! With Privacy Thing, you decide what any website can see about you: location, language, time zone, and much more. It reduces how you can be tracked from site to site.

updatePanelTitle.description: Popup panel heading shown after the extension updated to a new version. $VERSION$ is a major.minor number such as 2.1.

updateSeeWhatsNew.description: Popup button under the update heading; opens Update highlights in Settings.

updateMenuLabel.description: Player settings menu row shown after an update, in place of Extension settings; opens Update highlights. $VERSION$ is a major.minor number such as 2.1. Keep it short.

seekHoldDescription.message: Hold the Seek Forward key to play at 2x until you let go. A tap still skips 5 seconds. When this is off, holding the key keeps skipping forward.

copyrightHtml.message: © 2026 Tomasz Janusz. Released under the MIT licence.

replay.description: Button that plays the video again from the start once it has ended; it replaces Play on the player controls and also sits in the middle of the black end screen.

videoEnded.description: Announced to screen readers when the video has reached its end and the player shows its black end screen.

subtitlesLoadingNamedHud.description: On-video notice and screen reader announcement while a subtitle track loads. $LABEL$ is the track's name, usually its language (for example "Polish"); it stays in the track's own language and is inserted unchanged. Keep "subtitles" as the umbrella term and the label last.

searchSubtitles.description: Placeholder and accessible label for filtering subtitle tracks in the player menu

subtitleNoMatches.description: Empty result shown when no subtitle tracks match the search

autoTheaterSkipCountdownDescription.message: Enter as soon as playback is ready, without the countdown notice.

videoActivatorPromptDescription.message: AutoTheater is now off. Would you like a small button on videos to enter theatre mode manually? You can change this later in Settings → Features → Video launcher.

videoActivatorDescription.message: Show a small button on the left edge of a video when you point at it. Click it to enter theatre mode. On some services with Rich Theater Experience, the button is built into the service’s interface.

autoEnterTheaterDescription.message: Enter theatre mode when the main video starts playing on supported services’ watch pages with Rich Theater Experience enabled.

keepControlsVisibleDescription.message: Pin the playback controls and progress bar in theatre mode to keep them visible. The title and cursor still hide when idle.

nativeChatThemeUnavailable.message: Chat is using the service appearance. The selected theme is unavailable on this page.

nativeChatFullscreenUnavailable.message: Fullscreen with chat is unavailable. Theatre mode remains active.

shortcutExistingConflicts.message: Some shortcuts are assigned to multiple actions. Edit or reset the highlighted shortcuts to resolve the conflicts.

shortcutConflictDescription.message: $KEY$ is assigned to $OWNERS$. Move it to $TARGET$? The previous actions will no longer have this shortcut.

shortcutEscapeReserved.message: Escape is reserved for closing dialogs and exiting theatre mode. Choose another shortcut for this action.

shortcutSaveErrorDescription.message: Your shortcuts were not changed. Please try again.

bilibiliIntlIntegrationDescription.message: Available when provided by the video or player: Title, Subtitles, intro/outro markers, Thumbnails. Quick actions: skip intro/outro and next episode (episodes only).

crunchyrollIntegrationDescription.message: Available when provided by the video or player: Title, Subtitles, intro/credits markers, Thumbnails. Quick actions: skip intro/credits and next episode.

iqiyiIntegrationDescription.message: Shows the series title and episode label, lists and selects the episode's subtitle languages (shown by iQIYI's own player), marks intro and outro, and moves to the previous or next episode. AutoTheater is supported on episode pages. Audio tracks of an episode can be chosen too.

soopIntegrationDescription.message: Shows the broadcast or recording title and the streamer, marks chapters from a recording's title history, offers the player's previous/next recording and its next-video countdown, and AutoTheater works on live broadcasts and recordings. SOOP's own chat can be shown beside the video.

vikiIntegrationDescription.message: Available when provided by the video or player: Title, Subtitles, intro/credits markers, Thumbnails. Quick actions: skip intro and next episode.

aboutTagline.message: One player to rule them all.

aboutLetterOrigin.message: Thank you so much for choosing my extension! Theater Mode Everywhere was born out of my frustration with the many different solutions that were all supposed to provide one thing: a comfortable way to watch video. They don't deliver it. Most players on the internet lack features that should be standard.

aboutLetterProduct.message: That's why I created Theater Mode Everywhere: a universal player that, in my humble opinion, gives you a comfortable way to watch video everywhere, and can handle the non-standard, unique features of many websites.

privacyPolicyDescription.message: How the extension handles your data. The full policy is written in English.

aboutLetterFreeHtml.message: The extension is free and doesn't send any information about you or what you watch to the developer or unrelated third parties. Settings can sync through your browser account, and playback features can contact the service you are watching directly. If something doesn't work right, you can report it on GitHub.

aboutLetterStoresHtml.message: Theater Mode Everywhere is available on the Chrome Web Store, Mozilla Add-ons and Microsoft Edge Add-ons. I'd be happy if you share your opinion about it.

aboutLicenseNote.message: The extension is available under the MIT licence.

languageDescription.message: Choose the language for Settings, the popup, and player controls.

sponsorBlockMarkersDescription.message: Show markers from the installed SponsorBlock extension on the YouTube theatre timeline, using its colours.

rteSectionDescription.message: Choose service integrations and explore what each adds to theatre mode. Features depend on the video and the service.

rteNoteLauncher.message: Uses the native player toolbar when its launcher slot is available; otherwise uses the video overlay.

rteEmpty.message: No service has all the selected capabilities.

rteNoteYoutube.message: Depends on the video; ad skip and queue navigation when available.

rteNoteAudioTracks.message: On videos with several audio tracks, such as dubbed versions; not during ads.

rteNoteVimeo.message: Chapters and previews when provided; next in showcases.

rteNotePatreon.message: Subtitles, chapters and previews when provided.

rteNoteTwitch.message: Subtitles, chapters and previews on VODs only.

rteNoteDisney.message: Subtitles, previews and skip/next when the player provides them.

rteNoteNetflix.message: Previews once Netflix has loaded them; subtitles and skip/next when available.

rteNoteBilibili.message: Some subtitles require login; other features depend on the video.

rteNoteBilibiliIntl.message: Intro/outro markers only; skip/next on episodes, not uploads.

rteNoteTencent.message: Subtitles and previews when provided; next via the player.

rteNoteCrunchyroll.message: Intro/credits markers only; burned-in subtitles cannot be turned off.

rteNoteIqiyi.message: Subtitles, intro/outro markers and previous/next when the episode offers them; no timeline previews.

rteNoteSoop.message: Chapters, previous/next and the next-video countdown on recordings only; no subtitles or timeline previews.

rteNoteViki.message: Subtitles and previews when provided; next via the player.

rteSaveError.message: Could not save service settings. Please try again.

helpNavigationHint.message: $1 opens the controls bar at the settings button. On a menu button, $1 opens its menu and $2 from its bottom row closes it. $3 ends navigation.

helpSeekHoldHint.message: Hold $1 to play at 2x until you let go.

endScreenSuggestions.description: Accessible label for the recommended video tiles on the screen shown after playback ends. Titles and video details come from the video service.

providerSettingsButton.description: Button on a Rich Theater Experience service card that opens its settings dialog.

providerSettingsTitle.description: Provider settings dialog title. $1 is the service name, e.g. YouTube.

providerShowRecommendations.description: Switch label in provider settings and on the end curtain. Controls the recommended videos, not the curtain itself.

providerShowRecommendationsDescription.message: Show recommended videos when playback ends.
providerShowRecommendationsDescription.description: Description of the provider recommendation switch. Recommendations appear only when playback ends.

providerAutoTheaterGlobalOff.message: AutoTheater is off globally. Enable it in Features first.
providerAutoTheaterGlobalOff.description: Note below a disabled per-service AutoTheater switch when the global AutoTheater preference is off. Features is an options-page section.

setupTitle.description: Heading of the first-run setup shown in Settings after a fresh install. Theater Mode Everywhere is the product name; keep it untranslated.

setupProgress.description: First-run setup progress. $1 is the current step number, $2 the number of steps.

setupBack.description: First-run setup button: go to the previous step.

setupNext.description: First-run setup button: go to the next step.

setupFinish.description: First-run setup button on the last step: save the choices and close the setup.

setupSkip.description: First-run setup button: close the setup without changing any setting.

setupWelcome.message: Thanks for installing! A few choices decide what the extension does on the sites you visit. Nothing is saved until you finish.
setupWelcome.description: Intro on the first step of the first-run setup.

setupServicesTitle.description: First-run setup step title and summary label: which video services get Rich Theater Experience integrations (subtitles, chapters and similar).

setupServicesDescription.message: On supported services, theatre mode can add subtitles, chapters, thumbnails and playlists. To do that, the extension requests subtitle and preview files from the service itself. Nothing goes to the developer or to other companies.
setupServicesDescription.description: First-run setup step text explaining service integrations and their network requests. 'Subtitles' is the umbrella term for subtitles and captions.

setupServicesAll.description: First-run setup choice and summary value: turn integrations on for every supported service.

setupServicesAllDescription.message: Turn on extra features wherever they are available.
setupServicesAllDescription.description: Description of the 'All supported services' choice in the first-run setup.

setupServicesChoose.description: First-run setup choice: pick services one by one with switches.

setupServicesChooseDescription.message: Pick the services where you want the extra features.
setupServicesChooseDescription.description: Description of the 'Choose services' choice. The chosen services get the extra features.

setupServicesNone.description: First-run setup choice and summary value: no service integrations.

setupServicesNoneDescription.message: Plain theatre mode only. Every video still gets theatre mode and its controls.
setupServicesNoneDescription.description: Description of the 'None' choice in the first-run setup.

setupServicesFooter.message: You can change this later in Settings → Features → Rich Theater Experience.
setupServicesFooter.description: Footer of the services step. Settings, Features and Rich Theater Experience are names in the Settings page; keep Rich Theater Experience untranslated.

setupSummaryTitle.description: Title of the last first-run setup step, which summarises the choices.

setupSummaryDescription.message: Here is what you chose. Your choices are saved when you finish.
setupSummaryDescription.description: Text on the summary step of the first-run setup.

setupSummaryServicesSome.description: Summary value when some services are chosen. $1 is how many are on, $2 how many there are.

setupSummaryFinishAndOpen.description: Label before two buttons on the summary step that save the setup and open Website Exclusions or Keyboard Shortcuts.

setupProfileFound.message: Your Theater Mode Everywhere settings arrived from another device, so setup is not needed.
setupProfileFound.description: Shown instead of the first-run setup when settings synced from another device arrive. Theater Mode Everywhere is the product name.

setupOpenSettings.description: Button under the 'settings arrived from another device' notice: open the Settings page.

setupAgainTitle.description: Heading of the Settings → About card that runs the first-run setup again or resets every setting.

setupAgainDescription.message: Go through the setup again to change its choices, or reset every setting to how a fresh install starts.
setupAgainDescription.description: Text of the Settings → About card with the Run setup again and Reset to defaults buttons.

setupRunAgain.description: Button in Settings → About: open the first-run setup again with the current settings preselected.

setupResetTitle.description: Title of the dialog that confirms resetting every setting to its default.

setupResetDescription.message: Every setting returns to how a fresh install starts, also on other devices that sync your settings. The setup then opens so you can choose again.
setupResetDescription.description: Text of the reset confirmation dialog. Settings sync through the browser account, so a reset also reaches other devices; the first-run setup opens afterwards.

setupResetAlso.message: Also reset excluded websites and keyboard shortcuts
setupResetAlso.description: Checkbox in the reset confirmation dialog, off by default: without it, excluded websites and keyboard shortcuts are kept.

setupResetConfirm.description: Confirm button of the reset dialog: reset every setting.

setupResetCancel.description: Cancel button of the reset dialog: close it without changing anything.

setupStartTitle.description: First-run setup step title and summary label: how theater mode starts (key, button on videos, or automatically).

setupStartDescription.message: Theatre mode makes the video fill the window. Pressing $1 always starts it. Choose whether anything else should.
setupStartDescription.description: First-run setup step text. $1 is the user's theater mode key as Settings shows it, usually T.

setupStartKey.description: First-run setup choice: theater mode starts only with the key. $1 is that key, usually T.

setupStartKeyDescription.message: Nothing is added to the pages you visit.
setupStartKeyDescription.description: Description of the 'Only when I press $1' choice: the extension adds nothing to web pages.

setupStartButton.description: First-run setup choice: the key or the video launcher button. $1 is the theater mode key, usually T.

setupStartButtonDescription.message: A small button appears on the left edge of a video when you point at it.
setupStartButtonDescription.description: Description of the video launcher choice in the first-run setup.

setupStartAuto.description: First-run setup choice: AutoTheater, theater mode starts by itself on supported services.

setupStartAutoDescription.message: On the watch pages of supported services, theatre mode starts when the video plays, after a short countdown.
setupStartAutoDescription.description: Description of the AutoTheater choice. Do not write a number of seconds for the countdown.

setupStartAutoUnavailable.message: Turn on a service that supports it in the first step to use this.
setupStartAutoUnavailable.description: Shown under the disabled 'Start automatically' choice when no service chosen in the first step supports it.

setupStartFooter.message: You can change this later in Settings → Features.
setupStartFooter.description: Footer of the start step. Settings and Features are names in the Settings page.

setupKeysTitle.description: First-run setup step title: hold for 2x speed and volume boost.

setupKeysDescription.message: In theatre mode, a few keys do more than the page’s own player. $1 and $2 also work on any page with a video, except while you type in a field.
setupKeysDescription.description: First-run setup step text. $1 is the theater mode key (usually T), $2 the fullscreen key (usually F).

setupVolumeBoostDescription.message: Raise the volume up to 300%. Audio goes through the browser’s audio processing, and a brief spinner may appear the first time you enter theatre mode.
setupVolumeBoostDescription.description: Description of the Volume Boost switch in the first-run setup.

setupKeysFooter.message: See and change every key in Settings → Keyboard Shortcuts.
setupKeysFooter.description: Footer of the keys step. Settings and Keyboard Shortcuts are names in the Settings page.

setupSummaryStartKey.description: Summary value: theater mode starts only with the key. $1 is that key, usually T.

setupSummaryStartButton.description: Summary value: the key or the video launcher button. $1 is the theater mode key, usually T.

setupSummaryStartAuto.description: Summary value: AutoTheater with its countdown notice.

setupSummaryStartAutoNow.description: Summary value: AutoTheater without the countdown notice.

setupSummaryOn.description: Summary value of a switch that is on.

setupSummaryOff.description: Summary value of a switch that is off.
